purpose: Apples-to-apples AVBT vs baseline — both trained on original short VLKEB

train_protocol.hyperparams: S2_fixed: λ=0.2, neg_w=2.0, hinge=0.3, contrastive, 1 epoch, dsn=500

eval_standard_vlkeb.protocol: test_vllm_edit.py on data/VLKEB/eval.json, dsn=100, sen=10, seed=42
eval_standard_vlkeb.verdict: AVBT preserves standard VLKEB performance — no collapse when trained on matching distribution

eval_grounding_short.verdict: On short answers, AVBT improves swap +7pp with reliability held; still far from 55% Gate A target

S2_fixed_longform_on_orig_eval.note: Long-form AVBT ckpt evaluated on short eval.json without retraining — domain mismatch

interpretation: Training AVBT on the same short VLKEB distribution as baseline is essential. Standard benchmark: parity. Adversarial swap probes: modest +7pp gain on short answers vs +2pp on long-form grounding (44% vs 42% baseline).
